lines.text: Hermes Agent runs inside T3 Code now. No forks — and the proof is public.
One standalone bridge connects them in both directions over the Agent Client Protocol. T3 Code stays the cockpit. Hermes stays the runtime.
T3 to Hermes. Hermes to T3. Or mention at Hermes in any thread — and one linked conversation keeps going.
Thirty-nine tests passing. Three live flows. Zero upstream forks. Two independent reviews. Verified on macOS.
A founder's idea, executed by agents, reviewed in the open. MIT licensed. Try it. Break it. Contribute.
